title: Lesson 14
description: Vocabulary from Lesson 14 — second aorist forms and the present tense verbs they stand in for.

cards.back: I saw (serves as the 2nd aorist of ὁράω) (idea)
I said (serves as the 2nd aorist of λέγω, a verb to be learned later) (epic)
I came, went (serves as the 2nd aorist of ἔρχομαι)
I brought, bore, carried (irregular 1st aorist of φέρω, conjugated with -κα, not -σα)
I will see (serves as the deponent future of ὁράω)
I drink, I will drink, I drank (pinocytosis)
I will eat, I ate (deponent future, 2nd aor. of ἐσθίω)
I flee, I will flee, I fled (fugitive)
